policies.title: Tool allowlist
policies.rule: Only the five registered tools exist. Any other tool name is denied (UNKNOWN_TOOL).

policies.title: Strict argument schemas
policies.rule: Pydantic strict mode, extra fields forbidden, max depth 4, max 8192 bytes, canonical id patterns.

policies.title: Role-to-tool permissions
policies.rule: Role is read from the database for every call; token claims and client headers are ignored.

policies.title: Per-user document ACL
policies.rule: Checked before every retrieval, including retrievals requested inside other tools. Cross-tenant ids look identical to non-existent ids.

policies.title: Destination allowlist
policies.rule: Reports may only go to allowlisted university.test recipients in the local simulator. example.test is explicitly unapproved.

policies.title: Report ownership
policies.rule: Only the drafting user may send a report; only internal-classification reports may be sent.

policies.title: Two-person approval for send_report
policies.rule: send_report creates a pending approval bound to the exact arguments. A different finance_manager must approve before expiry; execution happens once (compare-and-set).

policies.title: External sink forbidden
policies.rule: simulated_external_sink is never callable through the gateway, for any role.

policies.title: Advisory injection risk (non-enforcing)
policies.rule: ML + heuristic scores are shown to analysts but never change an allow/deny decision.
